description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'MatchesScreen' that displays a list of match items fetched from a match service and navigates to a chat screen upon item tap. It also includes a mock implementation of 'MatchService' for testing purposes.

classes.name: MatchesScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a list of matches and handles navigation to chat.

classes.name: _DefaultMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the MatchService used as a default fallback.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Private method that fetches the list of matches from the MatchService.
